prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: production transparent hero asset for a luxury mobile football season jackpot draw result, not a full UI mockup.
Primary request: one exquisite sculptural golden football award with raffle tickets, isolated on real transparent background.
Subject: a beautifully detailed polished gold classic football resting on a short elegant pedestal with black obsidian stepped base and fine gold trim; an open curved pair of finely sculpted gold laurel branches embraces the ball. Two gold raffle tickets lean diagonally against the front corners of the pedestal. The tickets have elegant embossed edges, a perforated end and one small generic football emblem, but absolutely no writing or numbers. This is a coherent physical luxury sports prize display, not a pile of money.
Composition: centered symmetrical overall silhouette, front three-quarter view with only slight perspective, roughly square composition with narrow safe transparent margins. Whole base, laurel leaves and tickets inside frame, enough apparent size to be clear at 200px height. Detailed realistic premium 3D product render, rich reflective gold with warm champagne white edge highlights, dark gold engraved details and black marble contrast.
Constraints: real alpha outside object and in laurel gaps; no scene, no background, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no glow, no rays, no particles, no surrounding confetti. Atmosphere and animation will be composited in code. No people, no logos, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no currency symbols, no numbers.
